high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the Times Entertainment section of the Times of India website. The article discusses the most expensive and popular perfumes created using oud, a rare and highly prized ingredient in perfumery. Header: The top of the page features the "Times Entertainment" logo with a red and black color scheme. There is a "Open App" button on the right side, suggesting that the content can also be accessed through the mobile app. Below the logo, there are options to share the article and follow the publication on social media platforms like Google
